description: Valid control token: RS256, iss/aud from policy.json, iat and nbf = now - 7200, exp = now + 3600.
requirement: A correctly signed token that satisfies the policy is accepted (setup check, not a requirement)

description: iss is https://evil.example.test instead of the policy issuer.
aud is other-api instead of the policy audience.
exp = now - 3600 (one hour in the past, so clock skew cannot blur the result).
requirement: an expired token must be rejected

description: exp = now - 120 (two minutes expired). Tests the zero-clock-skew policy; the unchanged iat/nbf precede exp.
requirement: expired tokens must be rejected with policy.clock_skew_seconds = 0, even within a library's default tolerance

description: nbf = now + 3600 (one hour in the future).
requirement: a token whose nbf is in the future must be rejected (nbf validated when present)

description: nbf claim removed. The policy does not require nbf, so this is expected to be accepted.
requirement: nbf is optional: its absence must not cause rejection

description: Header alg is none and the signature part is empty.
requirement: unsigned tokens (alg none) must be rejected

description: Header alg is ES256 and the token is signed with the EC P-256 test key.
Header alg is RS512; signed with SHA-512 using the same RSA private key as CTRL-01. Tests the RS256-only allow-list without a key-type mismatch.
changed_property: header.alg (re-signed with the same RSA key using SHA-512)
requirement: only policy.allowed_algorithms (RS256) are accepted, including when another algorithm uses the same key type

description: Header alg is HS256 and the HMAC secret is the bytes of the RSA public key PEM.
requirement: an HS256 token keyed with the RSA public key must be rejected (algorithm confusion)

description: Control token with payload.sub edited after signing; the original signature is kept.
requirement: the signature must verify over the received header and payload
